description: Pay CityDesk in SOL (receive-only Solana Pay; GET /api/pay/intent shows the cluster and whether it is on). Returns a solana: transfer-request URL and QR to the operator's public wallet. You pay from YOUR OWN wallet; CityDesk never asks for or holds keys. Then call verify_payment.

amount.description: SOL amount, e.g. "0.05" (max 10, 9 decimals); omit when task_id is given

memo.description: optional, at most 64 printable characters; public on chain

task_id.description: optional: fund an approved task (tsk_...); amount and memo then come from the task

name: create_payment_intent
